name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Detective Story: Kienai Kokoro
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎DS きえないこころ
source:
[url=/c65]Jinguuji Saburou[/url] is asked to investigate the suicide of an elementary school girl from 20 years ago. When he visits the girl's school, he meets the school principal, who demands the investigation of another new case...

This story is DS exclusive hence no numerical. As a bonus it also includes five previous mobile line games (6-10) and six chibi style minigames.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
[url=/c65]神宮寺三郎[/url]受託調查二十年前一名小學女生自殺的事件。他前往少女生前就讀的學校，在那裡見到校長，而校長要求他調查另一起最近發生的案件……

本篇為DS獨家故事，因此沒有篇章編號。作為附加內容，遊戲還收錄了此前推出的五部手機系列作品（第6至10篇），以及六款Q版小遊戲。

[改編自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Jing%C5%ABji_Sabur%C5%8D]Wikipedia[/url]]
